hooks.text: 每局生成可无限扩展的技能树，路线能重连、重掷、退款并随时停用节点
hooks.excerpt: Each run gives you a new unique skill tree to explore Combine melee, ranged and more, like pet skills, for nearly infinite builds Dynamic expanding skilltree depending on your skill pathway Additional meta progression skilltree Shape the infinite Skilltree Collect skillgems and shape your skilltree Reconnect skill pathways Reroll skills, or the entire skilltree and alter the outcome Refund skills and flexible skill deactivation system
